# Makefile for texturing programs

CUDA_HOME ?= /usr/local/cuda-12.8
CUDATarget ?= sm_90
CXX ?= $(CUDA_HOME)/bin/nvcc
CXXFLAGS ?= -g -O3 -Xptxas -O3 -arch=$(CUDATarget)
LDFLAGS ?=

all: tex1dfetch

tex1dfetch: tex1dfetch.cu
	$(CXX) $(CXXFLAGS) $< -o $@
